title: PyPI upload credentials
whyItMatters: The .pypirc file stores usernames and API tokens for Python package indexes in plain text. Anyone with the file can publish packages as the person.
source: Python Packaging Authority, pypirc file format: the default file is in the user home directory - https://packaging.python.org/en/latest/specifications/pypirc/
notes: Only exists when the person configured index credentials. Tokens can be scoped and revoked in the PyPI account settings.

cleanup.signOut: Revoke the API tokens listed in the file in the PyPI account settings, so the copied tokens stop working.
steps: Revoke the upload tokens in the PyPI account settings.
Delete the file named in the plan using the file manager.
Check the account's publishing history for anything unexpected.
cleanup.risk: Removes the saved package index logins from this machine. Tokens that are not revoked keep working from any machine.
